title: One FedAvg Round
learning_objectives: Broadcast the global model, train locally, aggregate
Use distinct reproducible seeds per client
Relate one-epoch full-batch FedAvg to centralised gradient descent
entry_point: fedavg_round(global_w, clients, lr, epochs, batch_size, seed)
hints: `bs = len(y) if batch_size is None else batch_size`.
Aggregate: `sum(n * w for n, w in zip(sizes, locals_)) / sum(sizes)`.

failure_feedback.advice: All clients must start from global_w; aggregate with weights n_k/N.
Weight each local model by its client's number of samples.
